name: Just Travel
what: Just Travel is a B2B travel technology platform that enables travel agencies, creators, and businesses to launch and scale their own digital travel operations. Through white-label e-commerce, global travel inventory, payments, automation, and AI, we provide the infrastructure to sell travel products under each partner’s own brand.
